review_status: primary-abstract-evidence; exact conditions and identity review incomplete

sources.title: The Equilibrium between Glucuronic Acid and its Lactone
sources.finding: Aqueous glucuronic acid/lactone interconversion was measured. Temperature affects equilibrium composition and transition rate; mineral acid accelerates transition without changing equilibrium composition.
sources.boundary: No Cannabis assay, cellular compartment, physiological rate, or atom-mapped identity established by this abstract.

sources.title: Studies on the Hydrolysis of Glucuronolactone in Phosphate Buffer Solutions
sources.finding: Experiments re-examined glucuronic acid/lactone reaction and equilibrium and measured pH and buffer-concentration effects on rate constants.
sources.boundary: Reaction formula images and numerical rate equations were not evaluated; do not assign plant kinetic constants from this abstract.

inference: This gap warrants an enzyme-independent chemistry review, rather than assuming a missing protein is necessarily required.
next_checks: Review full experimental conditions and exact D-glucuronic acid/lactone identity
